verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships a software product, Visalaw AI, so a headless or CI automation question is a fair one to ask. The evidence describes only an interactive web product with prompt examples and a vague 'automate entire workflows' claim. It documents no CLI, API, headless mode or CI integration, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
